### 📦 Install / update
Download the DMG or ZIP below. Quit **VoiceInk ChatGPT**, then replace the app in Applications. Existing settings stay; the original VoiceInk remains separate.

Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. Approve in **Privacy & Security** if needed; do not disable Gatekeeper. ChatGPT audio access is experimental; included minutes and billing treatment are not guaranteed.

SHA256SUMS and release-manifest.json identify the exact packages and source.
